name: approver-ladder
title: Approver ladder
question: What does each extra approver cost in TVL capacity?
note: Under today's full-reservation rule the aggregate staked-WOOD face value needed is approvers / haircut / k times the open coverage: 4.3x at 3 approvers, 7.1x at 5, 10.0x at 7, 14.3x at 10. Decentralising the guardian set is a direct tax on capacity, which is the opposite incentive from the one you want. Compare against the shared-coverage scenario.
